|notes=This is the numbered black-on-white presentation of Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V). The Players Committee distributed it as Virtual Set #1 through Decipher. Both numbered PDFs record creation on 6 March 2002 and state tournament legality from 9 March. The numbered sheets print collector mark 1•11 with identical words and game values in the two ink layouts. The 2006 wording calls the same device “this device” and reverses the order of the two cards it can cancel. Other editions include [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Original unnumbered)|Original (unnumbered)]], [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered white-on-black)|Numbered (white-on-black)]], [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium)|Premium]], [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards1.pdf] — the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002); page 1, slip 11. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Same cards on the 5 March 2002 sheet: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf] (res.starwarsccg.org).
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark)]].
